reelection.rule: Rule: next even-year November for this House term. legislators-current.yaml ends the current term on 2027-01-03. The even-year November before that January 3 end is November 2026. The file has no election day, so no day of the month is shown.

vote_frequency.label: In this cached set only (the latest 40 House roll calls, not a lifetime record): 40 of 40. Yea or Aye: 20. Nay or No: 20. Not Voting: 0. Of 40 Yea or Nay votes where the Democratic majority could be computed, 40 (100%) matched that majority (majority = the side most of that party's members voting Yea or Nay took; on average 207 members of that party voted Yea or Nay per roll call).

stands_for.caption: Grouped by Congress.gov's official policy area. Shows how they voted, not why. Final-passage, amendment, and procedural votes can mean different things; read the note for each.

stands_for.majority_rule: Party majority = the Yea/Nay side taken by most members of that party who voted Yea or Nay on that roll call, counted from the party code in the roll-call XML (all members, including ones no longer serving). Ties have no majority.

said_voted.caption: Posts are shown as written. A post is matched to a vote only when it names the bill number or the bill's official title. A post can mention a bill for many reasons.
said_voted.topic_caption: Recent posts grouped by simple keyword rules that are identical for every member (published at /x_topic_rules.json). A post listed under a topic is not claimed to be about any specific vote; a post can appear under more than one topic.

posts.text:
By passing the Major Richard Star Act, we can finally ensure all disabled veterans receive the pay and benefits they have earned and deserve. I urge the Senate to join the House and send this critical bill to the President's desk without delay.
https://t.co/atrR3ASQZy

This Veterans Day, we honor the courage, dedication, and sacrifice of all who have served our nation in uniform. Gratitude is only the beginning. We owe our veterans and military families a commitment to the healthcare, benefits, and opportunities they've earned and deserve. https://t.co/uOiyLmHJP5

Pete Hegseth has illegally waged war against Iran and put our troops at risk by leaking classified information. We filed articles of impeachment nearly six months ago to hold him accountable and bring these abuses of power to an end.

House Republicans just voted to protect him. https://t.co/Wf9egyEgui

Americans have had enough of the failed Trump agenda. Democrats are ready to act to bring prices down.

It's time to cancel his tariffs and end the illegal Iran war.

We can reverse his Medicaid cuts and restore healthcare tax credits to lower premiums.

Let's get the job done.

I am glad to hear that my friend @ChrisMurphyCT has been discharged. Sending best wishes for a swift and full recovery. I know that he'll continue to fight with everything he's got for our state and nation, and I look forward to welcoming him back to work at the Capitol soon. https://t.co/RBRQ7qfQwx

This is a big win for Connecticut and New England. Revolution Wind will help power 350,000 homes and save ratepayers over $500 million per year. Proud to support this project—built by union construction workers—every step of the way! https://t.co/Re71npZ86j

Connecticut, today is Election Day! 🇺🇸🗳️

Polls are open until 8:00 PM.
If you are not yet registered to vote, same-day registration is available.

Visit https://t.co/Ls9oVkVSvB to find your polling location or learn more about Election Day Registration.

Make your voice heard!

When their 'Big, Ugly Bill' kicked 15 million people off healthcare, that wasn't enough for Dr. Oz and Secretary Kennedy.

They put forward a plan that would have even kicked cancer patients off Medicaid.

In Connecticut, we stood up, and we stopped them. https://t.co/6GUD6ppGOY

Over 8 months since Trump launched his illegal war in Iran, 21 servicemembers have lost their lives and 860 have been wounded.

The average household has spent $856 more at the gas pump.

Americans can't afford this costly conflict. Democrats in Congress are ready to end it now.

Happy Halloween to everyone celebrating across Connecticut and around the country. Whether you’re handing out candy or headed out trick-or-treating, I hope you have a safe and fun night. ￼￼￼🎃🍫👻 https://t.co/ddRqA8AD7r

Trick or treat? Under Trump, it's full-size price hikes for fun-sized candy.
 
Halloween candy prices are 4 times higher than overall inflation, thanks to tariffs and corporate price gouging.
 
It's time to cancel these costly tariffs and make big corporations pay their fair https://t.co/SCef3qJ19O

Republicans are kicking 15 million Americans off of healthcare to pay for tax breaks for the wealthy.

Now, Dr. Oz wants to make it even harder for you to sign up for an Affordable Care Act plan.

Enough! It's time to reverse these cuts so everyone can afford the care they need. https://t.co/ZY8WC4U1RL

Americans have spent an additional $101 BILLION to fill up their tanks thanks to the Iran war.
 
Meanwhile, Trump made millions from oil and gas stocks, enriching himself while you foot the bill.
 
It's time to end this war and suspend the gas tax to get some relief at the pump. https://t.co/oeJftK1L3c

Since Trump took office, the average family has paid $4,700 more for essentials.
 
His tariffs are raising your grocery bill.
His Iran war means higher prices at the pump.
His clean energy cuts have spiked utility costs.
 
The Trump agenda has failed Americans. Congress must act. https://t.co/3d22YEcLiJ

During Open Enrollment, Medicare beneficiaries can review their current plan and make changes to their coverage now through December 7th. Thanks to the Inflation Reduction Act, no seniors will pay more than $2,000 in out-of-pocket drug costs.

Visit https://t.co/y9Cw22nBLx today.

President Trump has repeatedly shown us that he is unwilling to stand up to Vladimir Putin. The United States Congress cannot allow him to abandon the Ukrainian people.

Every Republican should join with Democrats to demand the President enforce the sanctions he signed into law.

Millions of Americans struggle to put food on the table, but Trump and Republicans in Congress cut SNAP nutrition benefits and defunded food pantries to pay for tax breaks for billionaires.
 
On #WorldFoodDay, I'm working to reverse those cuts and ensure no one goes hungry. https://t.co/LmSrKdVSwu

Instead of putting an end to his illegal Iran war, Trump thinks buying diesel from Putin will bring down prices.   Don't be fooled. This won't do anything to lower costs. It will only put American dollars in the hands of a vicious regime that will use the funds to kill

Inflation is soaring. The average family has been forced to spend $4,200 thanks to President Trump. His tariffs are driving up grocery bills. His illegal war is hiking costs at the gas pump.

Democrats are fighting to stop his failed agenda and make life more affordable for you. https://t.co/LBe8MCmn54

Donald Trump promised to bring down prices on Day One. Gas has been over $4/gallon for 158 days, a new record.  The President might not care, but families struggling to make ends meet sure do. Congress needs to end his illegal war in Iran and suspend the gas tax NOW. https://t.co/K80HJ15Gg9

A COLA is always welcome news for seniors, but it won't be enough to keep pace with rising costs. While Republicans scheme to slash and privatize Social Security, Democrats have a plan to enhance benefits by making the wealthy pay their fair share. It's time for Congress to act. https://t.co/136xQrQW31

With oil prices on the rise, more and more families are struggling to afford their utility bills. We’re proud to announce $75.3 million in federal funding to help Connecticut residents heat their homes. Learn more about eligibility and apply for aid at https://t.co/tX4Ic5H0NC.

Italian Americans have made lasting contributions in Connecticut’s First District and across the country. This month, we celebrate their unique heritage, stories, and traditions which continue to enrich our communities. https://t.co/Qo0mMJOHAM

Donald Trump and his cronies would rather sow debunked lies about voting than defend their failed agenda.
 
Local elections officials in East Hartford and across the state are some of the best in the country, operating with the utmost integrity and ethics. https://t.co/MDm4dnrLJn

Donald Trump has targeted Rep. Ilhan Omar with inflammatory and racist rhetoric for years, now sending federal agents from his weaponized DOJ to raid her home.  No president should abuse their power to threaten or intimidate their political opponents. I stand with @Ilhan.

On Indigenous Peoples' Day, we honor the enduring cultures of Native peoples and the lasting contributions they have made, and continue to make, in Connecticut and across the country. https://t.co/Ch6Mmta2du

Taking care of your mental health should never be something to hide or feel ashamed of. This World Mental Health Day, we're working to end the stigma and expand access to support and care for all. You are not alone, and there is always hope. https://t.co/2XezoDstn0

Pete Hegseth put our troops in danger by leaking classified information and he's overseeing an illegal war in Iran that has cost lives. Now, he wants to stage an unprecedented public execution, exposing it to American families and children.

Secretary Hegseth should be impeached.

Even after the Supreme Court rejected Donald Trump’s illegal power grab at the Fed, he's still targeting Lisa Cook.

As Americans struggle to make ends meet, he should focus on ending his costly tariffs and reckless war in Iran, not petty score-settling. https://t.co/a6KaE1ld1f

Connecticut continues to lead the nation as a hub for clean hydrogen and fuel cell technologies.
 
As we recognize National Hydrogen and Fuel Cell Day, we must continue to build on the progress we've made to boost clean energy production, lower fuel costs, and reduce emissions. https://t.co/JsbA2s7Pk9

President Trump's tariffs are driving up costs everywhere you look.

A new report found that without these tariffs, prices would have gone down.

While Republicans rubber-stamp the failed Trump agenda, Democrats want to end these tariffs and make life more affordable for you. https://t.co/NaKyHmhyKi

After severe flooding hit our state last month, this disaster declaration from @SBAgov is a crucial step forward for residents to get the help they need to recover.

We'll keep working to deliver federal relief to the communities impacted by this storm. https://t.co/EgMYDCjFzn

As inflation and unemployment continue to rise, President Trump is more focused on his illegal war and taxpayer-funded vanity projects.

Congress needs to act. It's time to cancel his costly tariffs, reverse his healthcare cuts, and end the war in Iran. https://t.co/50bOEQii2L

After Trump officials shut down the LGBTQ+ youth suicide hotline, we demanded a reversal to this cruel decision—and secured new funding to restart this critical resource. 

Specialized services for LGBTQ+ youth in crisis have officially resumed. 

Keep speaking out. It matters.

posts.text: Glad to join my colleagues and @GovNedLamont to announce a new federal grant to expand the Connecticut State Veterans Cemetery in Middletown. We'll continue to ensure the state has the resources it needs to properly recognize veterans and their families. https://t.co/22fpKyYTYK

During Domestic Violence Awareness Month, we stand with survivors and reaffirm our commitment to supporting them with the help they need. Everyone deserves to live free from violence, fear, and abuse.

If you or a loved one is suffering, call 800-799-SAFE for free, 24/7 help. https://t.co/kVhLbUTNri

For 50 years, the Hyde Amendment has blocked access to safe and legal abortion for low-income women.
 
No one should be denied the care they need because of who they are or where they live.
 
Let's pass the #EACHAct to end this discriminatory coverage ban on reproductive care.

As we recognize Hispanic Heritage Month, we celebrate the rich cultures, traditions, and contributions of Hispanic and Latino communities across Connecticut and the country. We are a nation of immigrants, and our diversity only makes us stronger. https://t.co/r1JDUcj5Y1

Every student should have the right to an education free from harassment and discrimination. It's shameful for Trump officials to reverse protections for sexual assault survivors and LGBTQ+ students in schools.

This dangerous decision must not stand. Our kids deserve better. https://t.co/rQvnyP7dVZ

posts.text: Armed with your personal data, ICE has been operating at airports to snatch residents out of security lines. We introduced legislation to cut off their covert coordination with TSA. ICE has been operating as Trump's personal army, accountable to no one. It's time to abolish ICE! https://t.co/q8JfjhOPlD

conflicts.caption: These are overlaps in public records, not evidence of a deal. Lobbying can be for or against a bill, and donors' employers didn't necessarily give money.
conflicts.method: Each itemized donor dollar is counted once, under the industry of the donor's self-reported employer; an industry counts if at least one LD-2 client in it lobbied on any bill this member sponsored or voted on.
